description: Reorganize the Settings root (buildSettingsMenu in MainActivity.kt) into four groups matching design image 07_PhoneSettings.png: CAR & APPS (Car & Connection, Duo screen, Apps & profiles, Display & Mirror, Input & Touch), PLAYBACK & WEB (Video & subtitles, YouTube, Browser), SAFETY (Safety bypass switch row with on/off summary and its existing confirmation + notification behaviour), GENERAL (Agent & Commands, Language, Advanced, About). Also move the Safety bypass row from Advanced to the Settings root as an inline switch. Independent of FEAT-002 and FEAT-003 — each touches a different file.
steps: 1. Read context.json first to orient. Read the ACTIVE portion of MainActivity.kt (start around line 1716+; everything before is commented-out legacy). Focus on buildSettingsMenu() (~L2545), buildAdvancedScreen() (~L2669), toggleBypass() (~L2725), duoScreenEntry() (~L2650+), and the SettingsGroup / settingsEntry / settingsListPage helpers.

2. Add new string resources for EN (app/src/main/res/values/strings.xml) and TH (app/src/main/res/values-th/strings.xml). New keys needed:
   - settings_group_car_apps  EN='Car & apps'  TH='รถและแอป' (replaces use of existing settings_group_car)
   - settings_duo_screen  EN='Duo screen'  TH='Duo screen'
   - settings_duo_screen_caption  EN='Panes, layout and content size'  TH='ช่อง การจัดวาง และขนาดเนื้อหา'
   - settings_app_profiles_caption_full  EN='Quick Apps for the car, per-app display and audio'  TH='Quick Apps สำหรับรถ การแสดงผลและเสียงแยกตามแอป'
   - settings_group_playback_web  EN='Playback & web'  TH='สื่อและเว็บ'
   - settings_video_caption_full  EN='Player, aspect ratio, picture, subtitle translation'  TH='เครื่องเล่น สัดส่วนภาพ ภาพ การแปลซับไตเติล'
   - settings_youtube_caption_full  EN='SponsorBlock and playback quality'  TH='SponsorBlock และคุณภาพการเล่น'
   - settings_browser  EN='Browser'  TH='เบราว์เซอร์'
   - settings_browser_caption  EN='Ad blocking, start page, user agent, site data'  TH='บล็อกโฆษณา หน้าแรก user agent ข้อมูลเว็บไซต์'
   - settings_group_safety  EN='Safety'  TH='ความปลอดภัย'
   - settings_group_general  EN='General'  TH='ทั่วไป'
   DO NOT rename or remove any existing string keys.

3. Rewrite buildSettingsMenu() to return settingsListPage with four SettingsGroups:

   Group 1 — label = getString(R.string.settings_group_car_apps)
   Rows:
     a) Car & Connection (existing: R.string.settings_car_connection, R.string.settings_car_connection_caption, R.drawable.ic_tile_car → PhoneScreen.CAR_CONNECTION)
     b) Duo screen (R.string.settings_duo_screen, R.string.settings_duo_screen_caption, R.drawable.ic_tile_settings → startActivity(duoScreenIntent()!!)). Use duoScreenEntry() pattern — include only when duoScreenIntent() returns non-null, to keep safe build working.
     c) Apps & profiles (R.string.settings_app_profiles, R.string.settings_app_profiles_caption_full, R.drawable.ic_tile_apps → showPhoneScreen(APPS) with appsFavoritesOnly=true)
     d) Display & Mirror (R.string.settings_display_mirror, R.string.settings_display_mirror_caption, R.drawable.ic_tile_mirror → PhoneScreen.MIRROR_SETTINGS)
     e) Input & Touch (R.string.settings_input_touch, R.string.settings_input_touch_caption, R.drawable.ic_tile_touch → PhoneScreen.INPUT_TOUCH)

   Group 2 — label = getString(R.string.settings_group_playback_web)
   Rows:
     a) Video & subtitles (R.string.settings_video, R.string.settings_video_caption_full, R.drawable.ic_tile_tv → startActivity(VideoSettingsActivity.intent(this)))
     b) YouTube (R.string.settings_youtube, R.string.settings_youtube_caption_full, R.drawable.ic_tile_youtube → startActivity(YouTubeSettingsActivity.intent(this)))
     c) Browser (R.string.settings_browser, R.string.settings_browser_caption, R.drawable.ic_tile_web → openBrowserSettings()). openBrowserSettings() is a new helper that starts the browser activity with an intent extra to immediately open its settings sheet (see step 5).

   Group 3 — label = getString(R.string.settings_group_safety)
   This group uses a DIFFERENT rendering than settingsListPage's contentRow — it needs an inline switch, not a chevron row. Add a settingsSwitchEntry() or render this group as a special case in settingsListPage (extending SettingsGroup or adding switchRow support). The row must show:
     - Title: R.string.bypass_setting_title ("Safety bypass")
     - Subtitle: R.string.bypass_setting_summary_on or R.string.bypass_setting_summary_off (depending on BypassPolicyStore.enabled)
     - Icon: R.drawable.ic_tile_settings with DANGER accent
     - Switch: checked when BypassPolicyStore.enabled; toggling ON shows the same AlertDialog confirmation (R.string.bypass_confirm_title + bypass_confirm_message); toggling OFF calls toggleBypass() directly.
   CRITICAL: the toggle must call the exact same BypassPolicyStore.toggle() + BypassNotifier path as today's toggleBypass(). Do NOT change BypassPolicyStore, BypassNotifier, or BypassControlReceiver. Do NOT change the notification channel, text, or behaviour. Only the UI location (from Advanced to Settings root Safety group) changes.

   Group 4 — label = getString(R.string.settings_group_general)
   Rows:
     a) Agent & Commands (R.string.agent_screen_title, R.string.agent_screen_subtitle, R.drawable.ic_tile_remote → PhoneScreen.AGENT_COMMANDS)
     b) Language (R.string.settings_language, caption=getString(AppLocale.selectedOption(this).labelRes), R.drawable.ic_tile_language → chooseLanguage())
     c) Advanced (R.string.settings_advanced, R.string.settings_advanced_caption, R.drawable.ic_tile_debug → PhoneScreen.ADVANCED)
     d) About (R.string.settings_about, R.string.settings_about_caption, R.drawable.ic_tile_settings → PhoneScreen.ABOUT)

4. Update buildAdvancedScreen(): REMOVE the bypass setting row and its duoScreenEntry() rows from the Advanced page. The bypass now lives in Settings root (Safety group) and Duo screen now lives in Settings root (Car & apps group). Keep the remaining rows: Diagnostics, Debug, Storage. Nothing else in buildAdvancedScreen changes.

5. Add a mechanism for Settings root > Browser row to open Browser settings. Two approaches: (a) add a new helper openBrowserSettings() that starts BrowserActivity with a special extra like 'open_settings_sheet=true', and BrowserActivity.onCreate checks for it and auto-opens the settings sheet; OR (b) simply open BrowserActivity (the user can then tap the menu to reach settings). Approach (a) is better UX matching the design. Add an intent extra constant EXTRA_OPEN_SETTINGS='open_settings' in BrowserActivity, check for it in onCreate/onNewIntent after the WebView has loaded, and call showBrowserSettings() if set. Then openBrowserSettings() in MainActivity does startActivity(browserScreenIntent().putExtra(BrowserActivity.EXTRA_OPEN_SETTINGS, true)).

6. To support the Safety switch row, extend the settingsListPage() rendering to handle switch rows. Option: add an optional 'switchState: Pair<Boolean, (Boolean)->Unit>?' field to PhoneLauncherUi.Entry (or a subclass). When present, contentRow renders a trailing switch instead of a chevron '›'. Implementation: create a contentRowWithSwitch() builder in the settingsListPage local code (or reuse AutoBridgeDesign.contentRow with a custom trailing view). The simplest approach: in settingsListPage, check if entry has a switchChecked property and render a different row. OR, handle it as a special row added to the body directly. Decide which approach is simpler — a special-case render in buildSettingsMenu for the Safety group is fine (just add the switch row directly to `body` instead of going through the generic settingsListPage for that one group). This avoids modifying the shared settingsListPage for one row.
7. Confirm the build passes: ./gradlew testPersonalDebugUnitTest assemblePersonalDebug
acceptance_criteria: Settings root page shows four groups: CAR & APPS (5 rows), PLAYBACK & WEB (3 rows), SAFETY (1 switch row), GENERAL (4 rows), matching design 07_PhoneSettings.png order and naming.
Duo screen row appears ONLY in personal/lab builds (not safe), using the existing duoScreenIntent() null-check pattern.

Safety bypass switch row shows current on/off state. Turning ON triggers the confirmation AlertDialog. Turning OFF disables immediately. Notification behaviour is IDENTICAL to before (BypassNotifier still fires).
buildAdvancedScreen no longer contains the bypass row or the Duo screen row.
Browser row in Settings launches BrowserActivity and auto-opens BrowserSettingsSheet.
All existing settings are reachable from their new locations — nothing lost.
All preference keys unchanged: BypassPolicyStore (KEY_ENABLED='bypass_enabled', KEY_SCOPE='bypass_scope'), and all settings behind the rows that moved.
New EN+TH strings added. No existing string renamed or removed.
findings: 1) BrowserActivity.EXTRA_OPEN_SETTINGS = 'open_settings' is the constant name for the intent extra that auto-opens the settings sheet. The companion object was made non-private to expose it. 2) openBrowserSettings() in MainActivity starts BrowserActivity with this extra. 3) The Safety switch row is built via AutoBridgeDesign.contentRow(trailing=null) + an android.widget.Switch appended to the LinearLayout. 4) SettingsGroup gained an optional customRows:List<View> field for non-standard rows (used by Safety). 5) duoScreenEntry() now uses R.string.settings_duo_screen / settings_duo_screen_caption instead of manifest-resolved labels. 6) toggleBypass() now rebuilds PhoneScreen.SETTINGS instead of PhoneScreen.ADVANCED. 7) The design shows 'Apps & profiles' and 'Video & subtitles' as row titles, but the spec maps these rows to existing keys R.string.settings_app_profiles ('App Profiles') and R.string.settings_video ('Video'). The existing string values were kept unchanged per the spec; a follow-up string-content pass could rename those values to match the design exactly without touching keys.
